what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 14023 Iraqi refugees in France, 5.2% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Iraq and Kuwait in 1990 and 1991, and armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iraq with the KDP and PUK from 1990 to 1992.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them, with the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam, IS and RJF among the opponents.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 1128 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 14094, at the end of 2023, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
